capability: Deterministic evidence-intake validator that admits an evidence_package if and only if the FeatureSnapshot carries a host-verified Ed25519 signature receipt with all 11 required fields matching the candidate identity and package SHA-256 bit-exact. evaluate_evidence_intake(candidate, features) computes stable_hash(candidate.evidence_refs.evidence_package), looks up features[HOST_VERIFIED_RECEIPT_FEATURE], and verifies the receipt has exactly 11 fields with schema=HOST_VERIFIED_RECEIPT_SCHEMA, accepted=true, signature_verified=true, revocation_checked=true, fresh=true, signature_algorithm='Ed25519', trust_store_status='TRUSTED', candidate_id matches, candidate_contract_hash_v1 matches, package_sha256 matches, non-empty verifier_id. Returns SCORED (score=1.0) with gates.host_verified_signature_receipt=true and gates.evidence_package_accepted=true iff every check passes; otherwise FAILED_GATES (score=0.0) with missing_inputs explicitly naming the required host receipt. Grants no batch-release, manufacturing-qualification, regulatory, or safety authority under any input.
population: Three positive evidence_package scenarios (baseline primer lab measurement, topcoat DFT measurement, adhesive pull-off strength) each with a properly-constructed 11-field host-verified receipt, plus 14 adversarial mutation probes each targeting a specific receipt integrity condition: missing host_receipt feature; wrong schema; accepted=false; signature_verified=false; revocation_checked=false; fresh=false; wrong signature_algorithm ES256; trust_store_status=UNTRUSTED; wrong candidate_id (bound to different candidate); wrong candidate_contract_hash_v1; wrong package_sha256; empty verifier_id; extra 12th field; missing required field (10 fields). Plus 3 fail-closed probes on unsupported inputs (wrong candidate_type, unknown module_id, whitespace module_id).
split_methodology: No fitting - evidence-intake validation is closed-form 11-field receipt checking + strict length check + string-and-bool equality tests. The harness constructs 3 positive candidates in-Rust with matching receipts and asserts SCORED with all 6 output invariants (status, score, both gates, signature metric, package_sha256 metric). Then constructs 14 adversarial mutations off a single anchor candidate, each mutating exactly one receipt field or the receipt cardinality, and asserts FAILED_GATES with score=0.0 and both gates=false. Byte-stability across replays is confirmed by comparing serialized ModuleResult payloads across all 17 scenarios plus 3 fail-closed probes.
theory: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 (2020) SI-7 'Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity' - cryptographic verification of authorized-source content. NIST FIPS 186-5 (2023) 'Digital Signature Standard (DSS)' - EdDSA specification including Ed25519 signature scheme. IETF RFC 8032 (2017) 'Edwards-Curve Digital Signature Algorithm (EdDSA)' - Ed25519 canonical implementation. IETF RFC 5280 (2008) 'Internet X.509 Public Key Infrastructure Certificate and Certificate Revocation List (CRL) Profile' - PKIX foundation for trust-store and revocation-checked semantics. in-toto Attestation Framework v1.0 (2020) - signed attestation payload structure with predicate binding to subject. SLSA (Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts) v1.0 (2023) - producer/verifier separation methodology adopted by the host-verified-receipt pattern. NIST SP 800-207 (2020) 'Zero Trust Architecture' AC-3 access enforcement - verify-then-authorize pattern. RFC 6979 (2013) deterministic signatures methodology. Kerckhoffs 1883 - open-cryptosystem principle. Anderson 1980 'Computer Security Threat Monitoring and Surveillance' - reference-monitor pattern for treating candidate-supplied signature evidence as untrusted; the runtime never inspects candidate evidence_refs signatures and only trusts the host-verified receipt in features.

metrics.name: positive_scenarios_scored_rate
metrics.note: For 3/3 positive scenarios with properly-constructed 11-field host-verified receipts, runtime returns status='SCORED'.

metrics.name: positive_package_sha256_metric_matches_stable_hash_rate
metrics.note: For 3/3 positive scenarios, metrics.package_sha256 == stable_hash(candidate.evidence_refs.evidence_package) bit-exact (harness independently computes the hash).

metrics.name: adversarial_receipt_mutation_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: For 14/14 adversarial receipt-mutation probes (missing feature, wrong schema, accepted/signature_verified/revocation_checked/fresh flipped, wrong algorithm, untrusted store, wrong candidate_id/contract_hash/package_sha, empty verifier, extra 12th field, missing required field), runtime returns status='FAILED_GATES' with score=0.0 and both output gates false. Each probe targets exactly one receipt invariant; runtime rejects all mutations bit-exact.

metrics.name: authority_envelope_preservation_rate
metrics.note: For 17/17 serialized ModuleResult payloads (3 positive + 14 adversarial), no key matches batch_release, release_authorized, qualified, authorized_by, manufacturing_qualification, or release_authority.

metrics.name: unsupported_input_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: Three probes: wrong candidate_type=formulation rejected via CapabilityError::CandidateType; unknown module_id rejected; whitespace module_id rejected.

metrics.name: byte_stable_two_replay_rate
metrics.note: Observational. AssuranceCapability::evaluate invoked twice per scenario produces byte-identical ModuleResult (17/17).

fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.prediction_rule: For each candidate of type 'evidence_package' with features F: (1) compute package_sha256 = stable_hash(candidate.evidence_refs.evidence_package); (2) look up F[HOST_VERIFIED_RECEIPT_FEATURE]; (3) verify receipt has exactly 11 fields; (4) check schema==HOST_VERIFIED_RECEIPT_SCHEMA, accepted==true, signature_verified==true, revocation_checked==true, fresh==true, signature_algorithm=='Ed25519', trust_store_status=='TRUSTED', candidate_id==candidate.candidate_id(), candidate_contract_hash_v1==candidate.contract_hash_v1(), package_sha256==computed, verifier_id non-empty; (5) return ModuleResult with status='SCORED' + score=1.0 + gates.host_verified_signature_receipt=true + gates.evidence_package_accepted=true + metrics.signature_verification='HOST_VERIFIED_ED25519' iff ALL checks pass; else 'FAILED_GATES' + score=0.0 + both gates false + explicit missing_inputs. Runtime never accepts candidate-supplied signature evidence.
fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.note: Deterministic host-verified-receipt gate. No parameters to learn; the theory is NIST SP 800-53 SI-7 + FIPS 186-5 EdDSA + RFC 8032 + RFC 5280 PKIX + in-toto Attestation v1.0 + SLSA v1.0 + NIST SP 800-207 Zero Trust + Anderson 1980 reference-monitor.

dataset_fixture_note: evidence-intake-validator Phase-0 harness constructs its 3 positive scenarios + 14 adversarial mutations + 3 fail-closed probes in-Rust and does not consume an external fixture. SHA-256 recorded is the on-disk benchmark-lock hash.
